_meta.indication: Treatment of adults with ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer with disease progression following at least one line of endocrine therapy.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, open-label, active-controlled, multicenter trial; patients randomized 1:1:1 to imlunestrant, investigator's choice endocrine therapy (fulvestrant or exemestane), or an investigational combination regimen.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with ER+, HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer previously treated with an aromatase inhibitor with or without a CDK4/6 inhibitor; ESR1m population by ctDNA (N=256).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival (PFS) per RECIST v1.1 in the ESR1m population.
pivotal_trials.n: ESR1m efficacy population N=256 (INLURIYO N=138; fulvestrant or exemestane N=118); overall trial enrolled 874 patients.
pivotal_trials.result: In ESR1m population, median PFS 5.5 vs 3.8 months; HR 0.62 (95% CI 0.46, 0.82); p=0.0008; ORR 14.3% vs 7.7%.

key_safety: Most common (>=10%) adverse reactions incl. lab abnormalities: hemoglobin decreased, musculoskeletal pain, calcium decreased, neutrophils decreased, AST increased, fatigue, diarrhea, ALT increased. Serious AEs in 10%; fatal AEs in 1.8%.
target_moa: Estrogen receptor antagonist that binds ER-alpha and induces its degradation, inhibiting ER-dependent gene transcription and proliferation in ER+ breast cancer cells.
modality: Small molecule (oral estrogen receptor antagonist / selective estrogen receptor degrader).
companion_dx_detail: Guardant360 CDx assay, a ctDNA-based NGS test to detect specific ESR1 mutations, approved contemporaneously as a companion diagnostic.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was held for this NDA application.

basis.text: Fast track designation granted 09 November 2021 for treatment of patients with ER+, HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer previously treated with endocrine therapy.

citations.quote: 09 November 2021	Fast track designation was granted for treatment of patients with ER+, HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer, previously treated with endocrine therapy.

basis.text: Application was reviewed as Standard (not Priority).

summary.text: Standard review NDA granted regular (traditional) approval based on the single randomized Phase 3 EMBER-3 trial; the drug had fast track designation, and Guardant360 CDx was approved contemporaneously as a companion diagnostic.

citations.quote: Based on an overall favorable benefit:risk analysis, the review team recommends granting regular approval to imlunestrant in the *ESR1m* population.
09 November 2021	Fast track designation was granted for treatment of patients with ER+, HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer, previously treated with endocrine therapy.

A supplemental Pre-Market Approval (PMA) Application (sPMA P200010/S021) was submitted to CDRH for the Guardant360 CDx assay. The sPMA will receive contemporaneous approval with this NDA as a companion diagnostic device for imlunestrant.

requirement.text: 4902-1 Complete the pre-specified, event-driven overall survival (OS) analyses comparing the imlunestrant monotherapy and standard-of-care endocrine therapy arms from the ongoing clinical trial, EMBER-3 (Study J2J-OX-JZLC), titled "A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-Label Study of Imlunestrant, Investigator's Choice of Endocrine Therapy, and Imlunestrant plus Abemaciclib in Patients with Estrogen-Receptor Positive, HER2 Negative Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer Previously Treated with Endocrine Therapy, to further characterize the clinical benefit of imlunestrant in patients with estrogen-receptor positive, HER2 negative ESR1-mutated breast cancer.
